title: k3s 스케일아웃 Phase A — 클러스터 골격 Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan to stand up a multi-node k3s cluster with Strimzi Kafka, Redis, and 4 app services to a passing cancel e2e smoke test.
notes: Procedural implementation plan (checkbox tasks, bash/terraform/yaml steps, deploy runbook). No status/decision frontmatter → not ADR. No user stories/acceptance criteria → not PRD. Embedded manifests are execution steps, not a standalone contract → the authoritative contract lives in the referenced design spec. Best fit is DOC (runbook/guide). Cross-refs the Phase A design SPEC.
